title: Solve-rate tests cannot distinguish strict from isolated assessment
reasoning: Every supplied solve-rate scenario gives strict_pass_rate and isolated_pass_rate identical values. Using isolated_pass_rate to classify solved checkpoints would therefore satisfy these assertions, even though a checkpoint with passing isolated tests and failing regression tests must remain unsolved under the required all-cases criterion.
reproduction: Substitute isolated_pass_rate for strict_pass_rate in solve classification; the cited scenarios cannot detect the substitution.
recommendation: Extend the existing solve-rate scenarios with checkpoints whose isolated tests all pass but whose strict pass rate is below one.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The checkpoint extraction tests distinguish the two rates, but the summary tests never supply divergent values when asserting solved classifications.
suggestedRegressionTest: Verify checkpoint, fully solved problem, and partially solved problem counts using a mixture of strictly solved checkpoints and checkpoints that pass isolated tests but fail regression tests.
